title: Sana'a Hearts: Romeo and Juliet Adaptation
subtitle: Chunk 3 - The Pact and the Warning
about: The lovers deepen their bond through a secret commitment while external pressures mount. A mediator warns of dangers, checkpoints prove treacherous, messages are mishandled, cousins clash, and violence erupts in public.

characters.name: Rami
characters.description: Sunni boy from old Sana'a family, intelligent and impulsive, torn between love and duty

characters.name: Zahra
characters.description: Shia girl, spirited and principled, values education and independence above tradition

characters.name: Yasin
characters.description: Rami's friend, enthusiastic but careless with secrets, accelerates events through his own enthusiasm

variables.name: Secrecy_Disclosure
variables.description: How likely their secret is to be discovered

variables.name: Family_Truce
variables.description: Willingness of families to tolerate the relationship

variables.name: Sectarian_Trust
variables.description: Cross-sect goodwill in Sana'a at this moment

variables.name: Love_Duty
variables.description: Rami's internal balance between love and obligation

encounters.title: The Olive Grove Pact
encounters.summary: Beneath the ancient olive trees outside Sana'a, Rami and Zahra seal their secret vow.
encounters.text:
The moon hangs low over the olive grove. Zahra's hand trembles slightly as she holds out a small object—a silver ring, her grandmother's, passed down through generations of women who navigated impossible choices.

'I won't ask you to abandon your family,' Zahra says quietly. 'But I need to know that when they call for you to march, to protest, to hate—I'll be worth the cost.'

Rami looks at her, then at the ring. The city lights of Sana'a glow in the distance.

'What do I say?' Rami asks.

options.text: "I choose you. Whatever comes after is theirs to bear, not me."
options.outcome: Rami commits fully. Love_Duty shifts toward love (+20). Secrecy_Disclosure rises slightly as passion clouds caution.

options.text: "Let me find a way to bring our families together first."
options.outcome: Rami seeks balance, but Zahra sees hesitation. Family_Truce gains ground while Love_Duty stays contested.

options.text: "I'm yours, but I can't promise what the future holds."
options.outcome: An honest answer that wounds Zahra's certainty. She accepts it but marks him as uncertain.

encounters.title: The Clinic Warning
encounters.summary: Dr. Al-Haddad, who treats both Sunni and Shia patients, pulls Rami aside after hours.
encounters.text:
Dr. Al-Haddad is a man who has seen too many young people arrive at his clinic with wounds that weren't meant for them. He pours two glasses of tea in the quiet clinic.

'I'm not here to lecture,' he says. 'But your father came through my doors yesterday—Sunni anger makes him reckless, and I saw it in his eyes. When men like him get cornered by pride, they don't think about consequences.'

He sets down his glass.

'If Zahra's family learns of you before the truce is real, Rami—you'll be an excuse for violence on both sides. Not a cause of love.'

options.text: "Then tell me how to make that truce happen."
options.outcome: The doctor offers cautious advice about approaching the elders through respected intermediaries.

options.text: "I'll be careful. We both will."
options.outcome: The doctor nods but his expression suggests he's heard this before from others who weren't careful enough.

options.text: "What would you have me do? End it now?"
options.outcome: The doctor shakes his head slowly. 'I didn't say that. I said be wise.' A non-answer, but honest.

encounters.title: The Checkpoint at Bab al-Yemen
encounters.summary: Zahra must cross a neighborhood checkpoint to reach the meeting place.
encounters.text:
Bab al-Yemen is more than an entrance—it's a statement. Tonight, young men in dark shirts stand near the archway, not official but never challenged by those who are.

One of them—Zahra recognizes him from her uncle's circle—calls out as she approaches with her bag.

'Late for something?' He smirks. 'Or someone?'

Behind him, his friends watch. Her phone is dead; she can't call Rami to cancel without explanation.

options.text: "Going to the clinic. Dr. Al-Haddad needs me for hours." (Lie with plausible cover)
options.outcome: The boy considers it, then waves her through. Secrecy_Disclosure drops slightly—she navigated well.

options.text: "What would you have me say?" (Defiant, risky)
options.outcome: He lets her pass but mutters something to his friend that makes Zahra's stomach turn. She'll hear about this.

options.text: "My aunt is ill. Let me pass." (Appeal to family duty)
options.outcome: He grins, respects the excuse even as he mocks it. 'Tell her I said get well.' Passes without incident.

encounters.title: Yasin's Mistake
encounters.summary: Yasin tries to help by delivering a message but nearly compromises them.
encounters.text:
Yasin burst into Rami's room, breathless with pride. 'I found her cousin—Nadia, the one studying engineering in Cairo during summer break. She's coming back next week, I told her you wanted to discuss... community service projects.'

Rami freezes. Zahra has no cousin named Nadia.

'Yasin,' Rami says carefully. 'What did you tell her exactly?'

options.text: "Start from the beginning and don't leave anything out." (Confront)
options.outcome: Yasin's face falls as he realizes his mistake. Damage control begins immediately.

options.text: "Who else knows you're involved in this?" (Damage assessment)
options.outcome: Yasin counts on his fingers. Three people at minimum, all of whom think it's a 'noble cause.'

options.text: "I'll handle it. You just... don't say anything more." (Shut him down)
options.outcome: Yasin nods solemnly, but Rami knows better. The enthusiasm is already spent.

secret_option.condition: If player has demonstrated cleverness in previous encounters (Love_Duty > 40 AND Secrecy_Disclosure < 30)
secret_option.text: "Nadia's coming back? Tell her I need her help with something else. Something she shouldn't write down." (Redirect)
secret_option.outcome: Rami spins Yasin's mistake into a cover story that gives him breathing room to fix the real problem.

encounters.title: The Family Council
encounters.summary: Rami's father calls a gathering of family elders—something is brewing.
encounters.text:
The room smells of qat and old paper. Rami sits on the edge of his cushion as his uncles speak in low tones.

'You know what they're saying about the clinic,' his uncle says, not looking at him. 'That our boys are being soft, that we've forgotten what it means to protect our own.'

His father speaks next, voice grave. 'There's a gathering planned for Friday. A statement. We need every son who still has honor in his blood.'

options.text: "I'll be there." (Commit—dangerous path)
options.outcome: His father nods, satisfied. But Rami now carries the weight of a promise that puts him directly against Zahra's family.

options.text: "I have university. Can't miss the semester." (Excuse)
options.outcome: His uncle scoffs but his father only says, 'We'll see.' The doubt is planted.

options.text: "What statement do you want made?" (Seek clarity)
options.outcome: His father's answer is vague: 'The kind that makes people remember who they are.' Rami doesn't sleep well.

encounters.title: Cousins at the Market
encounters.summary: Taher, Rami's cousin, runs into Zahra's brother at the spice market.
encounters.text:
The spice market is crowded with morning shoppers. Taher—boisterous, proud, the kind of man who wears his Sunni identity like armor—blocks the aisle.

'Well, if it isn't Abdullah,' Taher says loudly enough for neighbors to hear. 'Come praying we forget your people's sins?' 

Abdullah doesn't rise to it initially. But then Taher pushes past him, shoulder checking hard enough to knock a woman's basket over.

Spices scatter across the stone floor.

options.text: "Rami intervenes if present—pulls Taher back." (If Rami is there)
options.outcome: Taher scoffs at his cousin but backs down. Abdullah thanks him quietly, eyes cold.

options.text: "Abdullah lets it go—focuses on helping the woman." (If Rami absent)
options.outcome: Taher mutters something about 'softness' but the crowd's disapproval makes him leave.

options.text: "Abdullah responds in kind—words for words." (Escalation)
options.outcome: The exchange grows heated. A shopkeeper separates them before hands come out.

encounters.title: The Public Square Gathering
encounters.summary: Friday prayers draw crowds to the square—tensions are high.
encounters.text:
The square fills with men after prayer. Voices rise in recitation, then in speech. Someone brings a speaker.

Rami stands at the edge of the crowd, Zahra somewhere out there too—he knows she would come despite everything. The speaker's voice amplifies: 'They say we should forget! But forgetting is how they take us!' 

A stone flies—no one claims it—and hits a young man from the other neighborhood in the shoulder.

The square goes still, then erupts.

options.text: "Push through to Zahra's side of the square." (Find her)
options.outcome: Rami finds her briefly—they exchange a look of pure terror—before the crowd separates them violently.

options.text: "Get out before it gets worse." (Flee)
options.outcome: Rami slips away while the crowd's attention is on the wounded man. He missed her, but he's alive.

options.text: "Stay and help whoever needs it." (Humanity first)
options.outcome: Rami helps carry the wounded man to a clinic. Dr. Al-Haddad sees him, doesn't comment.

encounters.title: Blood in the Alley
encounters.summary: A confrontation after the square incident leaves someone seriously wounded.
encounters.text:
The alley behind the market is dark and narrow. Taher cornered—three men, all from neighborhoods that don't forgive.

They didn't want to kill him. Just teach him a lesson about 'respect.'

Rami arrives too late to prevent it but in time to see his cousin slumped against the wall, blood soaking through his shirt, one of the attackers still standing over him.

Taher looks up, sees Rami.

'Run,' Taher whispers. 'Don't be stupid.'

options.text: "Stay and help my cousin." (Duty)
options.outcome: Rami carries Taher to the clinic. His father finds out—knows now that Rami was there, in the wrong place at the wrong time.

options.text: "Call an ambulance and run." (Pragmatic)
options.outcome: Taher survives but wakes to find his cousin vanished. The family will hunt for him.

options.text: "Confront the attacker." (Dangerous)
options.outcome: Rami drives him off but takes a wound himself. Now both cousins are wounded, and Zahra's people are involved.
